questions.question: During a teacher-guided AI demonstration, what is the teacher's main role?
options: To help students understand how AI works safely
To let AI teach without any supervision
To stop students from asking questions

questions.question: Why are teacher-guided AI demonstrations useful?
options: They help students see real examples of AI in action
They allow AI to grade every student automatically

questions.question: Which is a benefit of using AI in everyday life?
options: It can help people complete tasks more quickly
It always knows every answer correctly

questions.question: Which of the following is a limitation of AI?
options: It can sometimes make mistakes or give incorrect answers
It always knows the latest information

questions.question: Why should people check AI-generated answers?
options: Because AI can sometimes be wrong
Because AI only works at night

questions.question: Which statement best describes AI?
options: AI is a helpful tool that works best with human guidance
AI is smarter than every human in every situation

questions.question: What is Creative AI mainly used for?
options: Creating new ideas such as stories, pictures, music, or designs

questions.question: A student designs an AI that reminds classmates to drink water during sports practice. This is an example of:
options: Using creativity to solve a real-world problem

questions.question: If you were designing your own AI, what should you think about first?
options: What problem the AI will help solve
How many stickers are on the laptop
What snacks to eat while coding

questions.question: Which AI idea would help students the most?
options: An AI that explains difficult lessons step by step
An AI that hides homework forever
An AI that cancels school every day

questions.question: Which of these is an important advantage of AI?
options: It can work quickly and help people with many tasks
It can think exactly like every human

questions.question: Which situation shows responsible use of AI?
options: Using AI ideas and checking them before sharing
Believing every AI answer without thinking
Using AI to copy homework without learning

questions.question: An AI drawing tool creates a picture from your description. What makes this possible?
options: Creative AI can generate new content from instructions
The computer copies every picture exactly
The monitor draws with a pencil

questions.question: Why is imagination important when designing a new AI idea?
options: It helps create useful solutions for real problems

questions.question: A teacher shows students how AI identifies different animals in pictures. This is an example of:
Which AI idea is MOST likely to help the environment?
options: An AI that reminds people to recycle and save energy
An AI that throws away useful items
An AI that keeps lights on all day

questions.question: What should students remember when using AI tools?
options: AI is a helper, but people should still think carefully

questions.question: Which question is MOST helpful when creating your own AI idea?
options: "Which day of the week is longest?"

questions.question: An AI that helps elderly people remember their medicines is an example of:
options: Using AI to solve a real-life problem

questions.question: Which statement best describes the future of AI?
options: AI will continue to improve and help people, but humans will still make important decisions
AI will replace every person in every job
AI will no longer need people to guide it
